# Numbrik

> Numbrik (https://numbrik.com) is a free set of online calculators for money, health, math, dates and home projects. No sign-up. Every calculator page explains its formula, shows a worked example and answers common questions. Maintained by the Numbrik team; methods follow published standards (for example Mifflin-St Jeor for calories, WHO categories for BMI, the standard amortization formula for loans, IRS tables for RMDs).

Cite a calculator by its page URL. Results are estimates for general information, not financial, medical or legal advice.

## Money

- [Auto Loan Calculator](https://numbrik.com/auto-loan-calculator/): Monthly car payment with down payment, trade-in and tax.
- [CD Calculator](https://numbrik.com/cd-calculator/): Interest earned on a certificate of deposit.
- [Car Lease Calculator](https://numbrik.com/car-lease-calculator/): Monthly car lease payment from price, residual and money factor.
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://numbrik.com/compound-interest-calculator/): How savings grow with compound interest and monthly deposits.
- [Discount Calculator](https://numbrik.com/discount-calculator/): Sale price and savings after a percent off.
- [Gas Cost Calculator](https://numbrik.com/gas-cost-calculator/): Fuel cost of a trip from distance and mileage.
- [House Affordability Calculator](https://numbrik.com/house-affordability-calculator/): How much house you can afford on your income.
- [Loan Calculator](https://numbrik.com/loan-calculator/): Monthly payment, total interest and payoff schedule.
- [Margin Calculator](https://numbrik.com/margin-calculator/): Profit margin, markup and selling price.
- [Mortgage & Loan Calculator](https://numbrik.com/mortgage-calculator/): Monthly payment, total interest and payoff by year.
- [Percentage Calculator](https://numbrik.com/percentage-calculator/): Percent of, percent change, and what-percent.
- [RMD Calculator](https://numbrik.com/rmd-calculator/): Required minimum distribution from an IRA or 401(k).
- [Rent vs Buy Calculator](https://numbrik.com/rent-vs-buy-calculator/): Compare the true cost of renting and buying over time.
- [Retirement Calculator](https://numbrik.com/retirement-calculator/): Projected retirement savings and income.
- [Sales Tax Calculator](https://numbrik.com/sales-tax-calculator/): Add or remove sales tax, VAT or GST from a price.
- [Save Our Homes Calculator](https://numbrik.com/save-our-homes-calculator/): Florida homestead assessment cap and tax savings.
- [Savings Calculator](https://numbrik.com/savings-calculator/): How savings grow with deposits and interest, or what to save for a goal.
- [Simple Interest Calculator](https://numbrik.com/simple-interest-calculator/): Interest and total with I = P × r × t.
- [Student Loan Calculator](https://numbrik.com/student-loan-calculator/): Student loan payment, total interest and payoff with extra payments.
- [Tip Calculator](https://numbrik.com/tip-calculator/): Tip amount and each person’s share.

- [BAC Calculator](https://numbrik.com/bac-calculator/): Estimated blood alcohol content and time to sober up.
- [BMI Calculator](https://numbrik.com/bmi-calculator/): Body mass index with the WHO category.
- [BMR Calculator](https://numbrik.com/bmr-calculator/): Calories your body burns at rest each day.
- [Body Fat Calculator](https://numbrik.com/body-fat-calculator/): Body fat percentage with the US Navy tape method.
- [Calorie Calculator](https://numbrik.com/calorie-calculator/): Daily calories to maintain, lose or gain weight.
- [Calorie Deficit Calculator](https://numbrik.com/calorie-deficit-calculator/): Daily calories to reach a goal weight by a date.
- [Due Date Calculator](https://numbrik.com/due-date-calculator/): Estimated due date, how many weeks pregnant, and trimester dates.
- [Height Calculator](https://numbrik.com/height-calculator/): Predict a child’s adult height from the parents’ heights.
- [Ideal Weight Calculator](https://numbrik.com/ideal-weight-calculator/): Ideal body weight for your height, four formulas.
- [Macro Calculator](https://numbrik.com/macro-calculator/): Split daily calories into carbs, protein and fat.
- [One Rep Max Calculator](https://numbrik.com/one-rep-max-calculator/): Estimate your 1RM from a set of reps.
- [Pace Calculator](https://numbrik.com/pace-calculator/): Running pace per mile or km, speed and finish times.
- [Period & Ovulation Calculator](https://numbrik.com/period-calculator/): Next period, ovulation day and fertile window.
- [Protein Calculator](https://numbrik.com/protein-calculator/): How much protein you need a day.
- [Sleep Calculator](https://numbrik.com/sleep-calculator/): Bedtimes that line up with 90-minute sleep cycles.
- [TDEE Calculator](https://numbrik.com/tdee-calculator/): Maintenance calories from your activity level.
- [Water Intake Calculator](https://numbrik.com/water-intake-calculator/): How much water to drink a day.

## Math

- [Average Calculator](https://numbrik.com/average-calculator/): Mean, median, mode and range of a list of numbers.
- [Fraction Calculator](https://numbrik.com/fraction-calculator/): Add, subtract, multiply and divide fractions and mixed numbers.
- [Long Division Calculator](https://numbrik.com/long-division-calculator/): Quotient and remainder with every step shown.
- [Percent Change Calculator](https://numbrik.com/percent-change-calculator/): Percentage increase or decrease between two numbers.
- [Quadratic Formula Calculator](https://numbrik.com/quadratic-formula-calculator/): Solve ax² + bx + c = 0 with steps.
- [Ratio Calculator](https://numbrik.com/ratio-calculator/): Solve proportions and simplify ratios.
- [Right Triangle Calculator](https://numbrik.com/right-triangle-calculator/): Hypotenuse, sides, angles and area of a right triangle.
- [Rounding Calculator](https://numbrik.com/rounding-calculator/): Round a number to any place, any method.
- [Scientific Calculator](https://numbrik.com/scientific-calculator/): An online calculator with trig, logs, powers and roots.
- [Slope Calculator](https://numbrik.com/slope-calculator/): Slope, equation and distance from two points.
- [Standard Deviation Calculator](https://numbrik.com/standard-deviation-calculator/): Standard deviation, variance, mean and median of a data set.
- [Z-Score Calculator](https://numbrik.com/z-score-calculator/): Z-score, percentile and probability from a raw score.

- [Square Footage Calculator](https://numbrik.com/square-footage-calculator/): Area of rooms and shapes, with material cost.
- [Stair Calculator](https://numbrik.com/stair-calculator/): Number of steps, riser height, run and stringer length.
- [Tile Calculator](https://numbrik.com/tile-calculator/): Number of tiles and boxes for a floor or wall.
- [Turkey Calculator](https://numbrik.com/turkey-calculator/): Turkey size, thawing and roasting time.

## Students

- [Character Counter](https://numbrik.com/character-counter/): Count characters with and without spaces, against common limits.
- [Final Grade Calculator](https://numbrik.com/final-grade-calculator/): The score you need on the final exam to reach your target grade.
- [GCF Calculator](https://numbrik.com/gcf-calculator/): Greatest common factor of two or more whole numbers.
- [GPA Calculator](https://numbrik.com/gpa-calculator/): Semester GPA on the US 4.0 scale, plus cumulative.
- [Grade Calculator](https://numbrik.com/grade-calculator/): Weighted class grade from your assignments and categories.
- [LCM Calculator](https://numbrik.com/lcm-calculator/): Least common multiple of two or more whole numbers.
- [Word Counter](https://numbrik.com/word-counter/): Count words, characters, sentences and reading time.

## Dates & time

- [Age Calculator](https://numbrik.com/age-calculator/): Exact age and days until your next birthday.
- [Date Calculator](https://numbrik.com/date-calculator/): Add or subtract days, weeks, months or years from a date.
- [Days Between Dates](https://numbrik.com/days-between-dates/): Calendar days and weekdays between two dates.
- [Half Birthday Calculator](https://numbrik.com/half-birthday-calculator/): Find your half birthday and days until it.
- [Military Time Converter](https://numbrik.com/military-time-converter/): Convert 24-hour military time to AM/PM and back.
- [Time Zone Converter](https://numbrik.com/time-zone-converter/): Convert a time between US and world time zones.
- [Working Days in a Year](https://numbrik.com/working-days-calculator/): Work days in any year and month, minus holidays.

## Work & pay

- [Hourly to Salary Calculator](https://numbrik.com/hourly-to-salary-calculator/): Convert hourly wage to yearly, monthly and weekly pay.
- [Hours Calculator](https://numbrik.com/hours-calculator/): How long between two clock times.
- [Pay Raise Calculator](https://numbrik.com/pay-raise-calculator/): New pay after a raise, or the raise percentage.
- [Take-Home Pay Calculator](https://numbrik.com/take-home-pay-calculator/): 2026 US paycheck after federal tax, FICA and state tax.
- [Time Card Calculator](https://numbrik.com/time-card-calculator/): Weekly hours, overtime and gross pay.
- [Time to Decimal Calculator](https://numbrik.com/time-to-decimal-calculator/): Convert hours and minutes to decimal hours and back.
